subtitle: FROM CONCEPT START TO DELIVERY STATE
title: We begin with the problem as it exists — not with a pre-packaged solution.
paragraph: Every transformation starts somewhere different. A ministry may have strong policy but weak implementation capacity. A programme may have funding but no unclear delivery model. An institution system may have trusted relationships but no data culture. A city may have the infrastructure it needs but an inaccessible business model. A public institution may generate large volumes of data and still struggle to turn them into decisions.

questionCards.title: 01  Where are you now?
questionCards.text: What is actually happening across policy, institutions, people, processes, finance, systems, data, technology and service delivery?

questionCards.title: 02  Where do you need to be?
questionCards.text: What would a credible target state look like for users, decision-makers, institutions, finance and accountability?

questionCards.title: 03  What has to change to get there?
questionCards.text: Which policies, processes, capabilities, operating arrangements, technologies, institutions and behaviours must move — and in what sequence?

bigCard.title: Define the decision before designing the work.
items: The decision that must be enabled
The people affected by the decision
How the client will be able to manage independently when the engagement ends
